name: True Religion Is
overview: True religion, as revealed in Scripture, is grounded in living a life of justice, mercy, and humility before God, as Micah 6:8 instructs. It is not merely external observance or religious buildings, but a heart transformed by God's love demonstrated through faith in Christ (John 3:16) and obedience to His way (John 14:6). Genuine discipleship is marked by love for one another (John 13:35) and reflects the kingdom of God characterized by righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit (Romans 14:17).
